steps.label: login / sudo / sshd
steps.sub: hand authentication off, don't check it themselves

steps.label: /etc/pam.d/<service>
steps.sub: config file matched to the caller

steps.label: Module stack
steps.sub: each module returns allow or deny

steps.label: One policy, everywhere
steps.sub: add it once, every caller gets it

code:
$ cat /etc/pam.d/sudo
auth     include   system-auth
account  include   system-auth

auth required pam_unix.so
caption: pam_unix.so checks a typed password against the hash stored in /etc/shadow.

code:
auth required pam_faillock.so preauth silent deny=5 unlock_time=900
auth [success=1 default=bad] pam_unix.so
auth [default=die] pam_faillock.so authfail deny=5 unlock_time=900
caption: 5 failed attempts locks the account for 900 seconds — 15 minutes.
